nonex: It does NOT always mean to fight or yell.
It does NOT mean to hit someone.
vocab.example: The two friends started to argue about which game to play at recess.
vocab.why: Argue is a word that helps you talk about disagreements without saying 'fight'!

vocab.def: To keep someone or something safe from harm or danger.
vocab.simple: Protect means to keep something safe, like a shield protects a knight!
nonex: It does NOT mean to hide something forever.
It does NOT mean to keep something for yourself.
vocab.example: We wear helmets to protect our heads when we ride bikes.
vocab.why: Protect is an important word about keeping the people and things you care about safe!

vocab.def: To say or write something back in response to a question or statement.
vocab.simple: Reply means to answer someone back when they ask you a question or say something to you!
nonex: It does NOT mean to ask a question.
It does NOT mean to repeat what someone else said.
vocab.example: Please reply to my question so I know what you think about it.
vocab.starter: When my friend asks me something, I reply by _______ ...
vocab.why: Reply is a great word for conversations. It shows you are listening and responding!

vocab.def: To take and use something that belongs to someone else, with the plan to return it.
vocab.simple: Borrow means to use something that belongs to someone else and give it back later!
nonex: It does NOT mean to keep something forever.
It does NOT mean to steal.
vocab.example: May I borrow your colored pencils for art class today?
vocab.why: Borrow is an important word because it means you plan to give something back!

vocab.def: To make or bring something new into existence.

vocab.def: To tell someone about a possible danger or problem before it happens.
